verdict: Lead costs crashed this week, but spend consistency needs to hold.
narrative: This period delivered 18 leads at an average cost of $91.55 per lead — a dramatic improvement from the ~$700 baseline seen prior to the Google Ads surge. The drop in cost per lead is real: a 195% increase in Google Ads spend drove a spike of 1,300% in leads over the last 7 days. However, Google spend went to $0 on October 3rd and 4th, which brought lead volume back down sharply in the final days of the window, so the efficiency gain is promising but not yet stable. Nine agreed milestones — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and intake setup — are past due and are being addressed now, as resolving these is the direct path to locking in the scale-up that the ad performance this week showed is within reach.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, with the large majority arriving in a single 7-day surge
average cost per lead this period, down sharply from a ~$700 prior baseline
total actions taken on your Google Business Profile listings this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: Your Quality HVAC Solutions listing is showing 954 impressions this period but converting to calls at only 1.47% — your second listing converts at 5.11% on far fewer impressions, confirming the gap is in listing content, not visibility.
watch_item.fix: The listing is being reviewed this week to strengthen the call-to-action and profile content so that visibility starts translating into calls at a comparable rate.
